name: Amazon Cognito
subtitle: AWS managed user pools
creator: Amazon Web Services

version.label: Hosted service (Lite, Essentials and Plus tiers)

description: AWS's managed identity service. User pools store accounts and handle sign-in, MFA and social login; identity pools hand out temporary AWS credentials so users can access other AWS services directly.
useCases: Serverless back ends with Lambda and API Gateway

languages.youWrite: AWS SDKs or Amplify libraries in any language

concepts.explanation: Lambda functions during sign-up and sign-in.

codeSamples.label: TypeScript · AWS Amplify

cons: Developer experience is widely considered clunky

pricing.summary: First 10,000 MAU free each month. Essentials then $0.015 per MAU; Lite from $0.0055 per MAU. SAML/OIDC federation: 50 MAU free, then $0.015 per MAU.
